what_changed: CFPB withdraws its Regulation AA proposal (90 FR 3566, Jan. 14, 2025) as of May 15, 2025, citing duplication of the FTC Credit Practices Rule, a policy of limiting regulatory burden and comments questioning its authority; it will take no further action on that proposal.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change to current obligations: the proposed 12 CFR part 1027 (late-fee pyramiding, cosigner, contract-term prohibitions) will not be adopted by the CFPB. Existing duties remain: the FTC Credit Practices Rule (16 CFR part 444) for creditors under FTC jurisdiction and UDAAP generally.
rationale: Full text confirms the withdrawal of a proposal judged relevant in Stage B (2025-00633); withdrawing a proposed servicing-conduct rule is a change under the test. Stage B: read SUMMARY, DATES, SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION and any regulatory text from the saved GovInfo full text (479 of 479 words).
